name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on reinforcing EU’s unwavering support to Ukraine against Russia’s war of aggression and the increasing military cooperation between North Korea and Russia
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to keep backing Ukraine against Russia's war and to step up military aid, including air defence systems, long-range missiles and ammunition. It asks member states to spend at least 0.25% of their yearly economic output on military support for Ukraine. It also condemns North Korea for sending troops and weapons to Russia, and urges tougher sanctions on Russia, North Korea, Iran, Belarus and Chinese companies helping Russia.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament is urging EU governments and the Commission to act, not passing law.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, Ukraine, Russia, North Korea, Iran, Belarus, China and South Korea.
- **What happens next:** EU governments decide whether to follow these calls; Parliament wants faster weapons deliveries and new sanctions.
